## Site decision

A rendered correction is justified because production advertises an obsolete release and immutable product snapshot while the authoritative product repository has advanced to `v1.0.3` with a new primary product view.

The smallest coherent outcome is to:

- update release labels, release URL, release date, structured software version, machine-readable release summary, and immutable product commit from `v0.2.68` to `v1.0.3`;
- add the new Overview dashboard to the existing homepage product walkthrough without changing routes or navigation;
- update the changelog with the verified dashboard, operation-stack profiling, and correctness-fix highlights;
- advance the compatible shared SEO skill pointer;
- preserve existing installation claims, documentation ownership, analytics policy, static export, route inventory, and visual system.

The cycle does not add a new content page, introduce an npm installation claim, perform a broad rewrite, or change canonical ownership. The public-search finding is retained for later Search Console-backed validation rather than combined with this release correction.
